title: macOS (GitHub-hosted VM)
machine: GitHub-hosted macos-15 runner: Apple M1 (Virtual) virtual machine, 3 vCPU, 7 GB, no GPU acceleration, macOS 15.8.2.
memory_metric: physical footprint of the whole process tree
notes: A virtual machine, not a real Mac: absolute numbers differ from hardware; compare v1 with v2 within this run only. Alternating AB/BA blocks, disposable profiles with identical 51,000-file fixtures, one 60-second priming launch per profile, profiles excluded from Spotlight; observer key-to-frame floor median 27.2 ms.

Bounds are ScreenCaptureKit frame and idle-sample times of the palette region, from CGEvent dispatch start; frames are classified by Vision OCR after each capture window. Second Settings row from the explore pass: 'System Settings' (v1), 'Window Management Settings' (v2). A palette shown at launch is dismissed with Escape before the hidden phase. The action menu is not measured (v1 has none).

The stable-list signature is all OCR text below the input (titles, subtitles, right-hand values, footer), stricter than Linux's row titles; v2 sometimes changes that text 0.5–1.5 s after its first matching frame, which moves the endpoint later or fails it as unstable. On this VM v2 also showed repeatable ~0.5 s capture gaps (no frame or idle sample) after Down and Enter, kept as measured.
